svg.title: Checkout lifecycle
svg.desc: The checkout form opens with a cart (checkout.started). While the shopper fills it, user.created, user.updated, address.entered, address.updated, shipping.selected and payment.selected arrive in any order. A submit, or an express button, starts submitting: the cart is frozen while the form, the cart and the card are checked. A check that fails sends checkout.submitted with valid false and goes back to filling. Checks that pass send checkout.submitted with valid true and place the order. A refused order sends order.failed and goes back to filling. A created order sends order.created once. Without a payment_complete_url it is paid and the shopper is redirected to the next page (next-success-url, or the order status page); with one the shopper is redirected there to pay (PayPal, 3-D Secure, …): paid, the gateway redirects them to the next page; failed, back to the checkout with the cart kept (order.failed). The next page sends order.loaded, then order.paid once per order. A paid order empties the cart.

text.tspan: The next page is next-success-url, or the order status page: order.loaded, then order.paid once per order
A paid order empties the cart without cart events; while payment is awaited the cart is kept
